coverage: Every listed chart state has two independent visual passes. Official source prose, tables, tab labels, captions and footnotes were also read. Non-benchmark product demos excluded.
render_limitations: Astra and remaining Sol 6.1 views use official embedded Vega-Lite specs rendered locally because isolated Chrome official script requests returned 403 and hydration failed. These are derivative source views, not pixel replicas. Layout/font/palette and chart-width bindings were adapted; exact source specs retained. Some Astra left-aligned titles/model legends clip in source render; complete exact titles and captions were separately inspected. Evaluation identities unchanged.
